draft.subject: Photographing Aurora Strings at Carnegie Hall.
draft.body: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw Aurora Strings is performing at Carnegie Hall on March 10. Nearly ten years of shooting that hall have taught me how to work it without a flash and without being noticed. You can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If your photography plans for the evening are not settled, I would be glad to talk. I look forward to hearing from you.
